snippet.title: My Liege - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The official trailer for My Liege, a choose your own adventure RPG where you lead your noble house as lord. As the smallest noble house in the realm, it falls on you to lead your family through turmoil and tragedy.

Special thanks to Jeff Steitzer for the voiceover and my brother Tyler for the music!

Releasing on Steam on March 31, 2025!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809520/My_Liege/
